response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and agentic workflows in his current Staff role, plus solid high-throughput distributed systems experience from Dunnhumby, but the resume shows no evidence of Python (a stated must-have), and lacks clear signals of stakeholder management, operational on-call ownership, or agile ceremony participation expected at this level.
strengths: Current role directly involves AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflow tooling
Proven experience building low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems handling millions of requests/sec
Long, diverse full-stack track record with strong TypeScript skills and craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based dev)
concerns: No mention of Python anywhere in skills or experience, despite it being a must-have
No explicit evidence of cross-functional stakeholder management or on-call/incident-response ownership
Career shows many lateral senior/staff titles across smaller companies rather than clear escalating technical-strategy scope
